title: Nazi Zombie Dawnville 2
author: Gbomb

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: nazi_zombie_dawn2 is a large scale zombie map. It’s based on my previous map release Dawnville, which was designed after the classic multiplayer map from Call of Duty 1 and 2. Dawn2 has it all, but it is very difficult and not for wimps You must stay alive long enough to unlock all the blockers and power up the fire defense and perk machines. In this map, all the perks exist but they are hidden throughout the map. Good luck staying alive! – Lots of unlockable rooms and doors. – Perk-a-Cola machines including juggernaut. – Power switch and custom wall of fire defense. – Mounted machine gun. – Moving weapons box. – Bouncing Betty. – Rising Zombies. – Lots of special effects and more!

notes: Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).
